check:
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import random
import re
import unicodedata

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("candidate", Path.cwd() / "solution.py")
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
fixed = {
    "": "",
    "  Hello, World! ": "hello-world",
    "Crème brûlée": "creme-brulee",
    "İstanbul Çığ": "istanbul-cg",
    "a--b__c": "a-b-c",
    "😀": "",
    "A123": "a123",
}
for text, expected in fixed.items():
    assert module.slugify(text) == expected, (text, expected)
rng = random.Random(9042)
alphabet = "aBcD012 _-,.!éüİç😀"
for _ in range(160):
    text = "".join(rng.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(rng.randrange(80)))
    plain = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", text).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode().lower()
    expected = re.sub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", plain).strip("-")
    assert module.slugify(text) == expected

check:
import copy
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import random

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("candidate", Path.cwd() / "solution.py")
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
fixed = [([], []), ([(1, 3), (3, 5)], [(1, 5)]), ([(0, 0)], []),
         ([(4, 7), (-3, 1), (0, 6), (8, 8)], [(-3, 7)]),
         ([(1, 10), (2, 3)], [(1, 10)])]
for intervals, expected in fixed:
    before = copy.deepcopy(intervals)
    assert module.merge_intervals(intervals) == expected
    assert intervals == before
for invalid, error in [([(2, 1)], ValueError), ([(1.0, 2)], TypeError),
                       ([(True, 2)], TypeError), ([(0, "2")], TypeError)]:
    try:
        module.merge_intervals(invalid)
    except error:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError("invalid interval accepted")
rng = random.Random(9042)
for _ in range(160):
    intervals = []
    for _ in range(rng.randrange(20)):
        start = rng.randrange(-10, 11)
        intervals.append((start, start + rng.randrange(10)))
    covered = sorted({unit for start, end in intervals for unit in range(start, end)})
    expected = []
    for unit in covered:
        if expected and expected[-1][1] == unit:
            expected[-1] = (expected[-1][0], unit + 1)
        else:
            expected.append((unit, unit + 1))
    before = copy.deepcopy(intervals)
    assert module.merge_intervals(intervals) == expected
    assert intervals == before

import copy
import importlib.util
from itertools import permutations
from pathlib import Path
import random

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("candidate", Path.cwd() / "solution.py")
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
for nodes, edges, expected in [([], [], []), (["c", "b", "a"], [], ["a", "b", "c"]),
                              (["a", "a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("a", "b")], ["a", "b"]),
                              (["a", "b", "c"], [("c", "a")], ["b", "c", "a"])]:
    before = copy.deepcopy((nodes, edges))
    assert module.plan(nodes, edges) == expected
    assert (nodes, edges) == before
for nodes, edges in [(["a"], [("a", "a")]), (["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")]),
                     (["a"], [("a", "unknown")])]:
    try:
        module.plan(nodes, edges)
    except ValueError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError("invalid graph accepted")
rng = random.Random(9042)
for _ in range(40):
    nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f"]
    order = nodes[:]
    rng.shuffle(order)
    edges = [(order[a], order[b]) for a in range(6) for b in range(a + 1, 6) if rng.randrange(3) == 0]
    expected = next(list(p) for p in permutations(nodes)
                    if all(p.index(a) < p.index(b) for a, b in edges))
    rng.shuffle(nodes)
    before = copy.deepcopy((nodes, edges))
    assert module.plan(nodes, edges) == expected
    assert (nodes, edges) == before
